messages.content: Can you find the contact card for alice and get her checking account balance sheet? Once you have that, please archive the balance sheet as "Q3 Balance Archive" with high priority via email. I also need you to take a snapshot of the /var/workspaces/finance workspace using that same "Q3 Balance Archive" title and the same high priority email notification settings. After that, please check the current price of BTC and place a 5000.0 equity order for it. Finally, fetch the latest business news bulletin pack for me.
